title: How to make Tiles, Events, and other things in 16x16 format?

posts.author: Clarmo25
posts.body: Hello, guys. I'm new to this forum and to the engine in principle. I have a question, how to make graphics in RPG Maker MV 16 by 16 pixels or 32 by 32? What plugins to use, or do without plugins? I will be glad to any answer!

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
Change Tile Size
Change Tile Size     by Shaz     version 1.1 2016.10.23      Introduction     This plugin allows you to change from the default tile size of 48x48 to something larger or smaller.      How to use     Add to your plugins folder (file name should be ChangeTileSize.js).      Set the Tile Size...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com

posts.author: alice_gristle
posts.body: If you don't wanna use plugins, what I do to sort of fake 16x16 pixel style, is just upscale all my relevant assets 300%!

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
you can also do it completely without plugins by only simulating 16x16.
MV's 48x48 is 300% of 16x16, so you can simply make 48x48 tiles where only blocks of 3x3 pixels are placed, with each block of 3x3 standing for one single pixel in 16x16.
